limitations: L4 is offline synthetic fixture acceptance only; physical, biological and process validity remain unverified.
Intervals assume independent homoscedastic normal replicate errors. A declared run order cannot establish actual randomisation.
Coefficients are half-differences. Fractional aliases cannot be separated; centre curvature cannot identify an individual quadratic term.
Hashes cannot prove historical freeze timing or true source independence; review remains unavailable.

Conservative case-insensitive English whole-word/prefix families: caus*, mechanis*, therap*, clinic*, efficac*, effective*, treat*, cure*, prevent*, recommend*, prescri*, bind*, affinit*, inhibit*, activat*, regulat*, drive/drives/driv*, induc*. Additional refusals: truth, physical validity, patient benefit, optim*, scale-up and process validity. The gate includes negations and is incomplete.
Unavailable evidence requires unavailable claims. Computed agreement and review approval never support positive claims; this synthetic fixture never establishes replication.
Read-only input budgets: 64 MiB each, 256 MiB aggregate, 4000000 JSON values, four factors, 17 conditions, 128 replicates per condition and 4096 total observations.
